name: Charli XCX
who_line: A pop star who dresses like she would in real life, and buys a lot of it second-hand.
who: English singer and songwriter. Added in the 28 Oct 2026 pulse because of her Vinted announcement: a tour wardrobe built partly from second-hand finds, and a resale of her own closet for charity.
work: Her Music, Fashion, Film tour was a 12-date North American arena run that ended in Las Vegas on 23 October 2026, with guests including Chappell Roan, Tinashe and Underscores (ELLE UK).

quotes.text: Vintage and second-hand are a huge part of my style. Chris and I love mixing older, iconic pieces with newer things. I think it makes a look feel more personal to me and always takes us to a more unexpected place.
Some were found on Vinted in the first place, worn on stage, and are now going back out into the world. Which feels like a full circle.

why_the_look: On this tour she and her longtime stylist Chris Horan aimed for clothes she would wear in real life rather than dressing like a pop star (ELLE UK), and sourced pre-loved pieces on Vinted with search terms like “distressed”, “gothic” and “flounce”.

moments.title: Music, Fashion, Film tour — second-hand on stage, then back out to resale (added 28 Oct 2026 pulse)
moments.garments: Tour pieces sourced on Vinted: an early-2000s Christian Audigier piece reworked into a dress for Austin City Limits, a sheer grey blouse worn in San Diego, and a black Roberto Cavalli dress worn to the Academy Gala after-party in Los Angeles and at the Las Vegas finale. Announced for her Vinted resale: ripped-up Ann Demeulemeester tees, Balmain lace-up leather trousers and a brocade corset bodysuit worn on tour, sheer Betsey Johnson tops worn on stage, Zana Bayne lace-and-leather pieces from the “Rock Music” video, an R&M Leathers leather jacket, a pink Acne Studios dress, a custom silver Zadig & Voltaire blazer and vintage tees.
moments.designer_season: Labels as named by Vinted, ELLE UK and NYLON. No season is given for any piece, and the Audigier is dated only “early-2000s”.
moments.where_it_lives: Selected pieces go on sale on Vinted in the UK, US and Australia from Monday 16 November 2026. All proceeds go to Rainbow Railroad, which helps LGBTQI+ people facing persecution reach safety.
moments.why_iconic: A headline pop tour dressed partly from second-hand listings, with the clothes sent back into circulation afterwards. It is the thrift loop cool dairy runs on, at arena scale.

moments.title: Airbnb.org gala — archive Roberto Cavalli on the red carpet (added 29 Oct 2026 pulse)
moments.garments: A strapless bronze-gold lamé gown, ruched through the bodice and hips, with black floral appliqué down the front, a high front slit edged in black feathers and a black feather hem. Worn with black satin pumps at Airbnb.org's first gala, Milk Studios, Los Angeles, 28 October 2026.
moments.designer_season: Roberto Cavalli, per Just Jared's red-carpet gallery. The Fall/Winter 2005 season is a fan identification (X user @ship_gq), not confirmed by press; it lines up visually with a Cavalli runway look and with Vogue's Fall 2005 review, which describes lamé and feathered eveningwear.
moments.where_it_lives: Worn on the red carpet; no resale or Vinted link announced for this piece.
moments.why_iconic: Days after the Vinted announcement, she wears a twenty-year-old Cavalli runway gown to a charity gala instead of a new-season loan. Archive dressing on a red carpet is the cool dairy argument in one picture.
